rationale: Reproduction check of the growth experiment (fixed experiment 01878d6cc9e24ccb8fd3d9157f560ea3-experiment) from its retained inputs in a clean copy. This finding currently rests on one receipt plus the control built in the same execution, and its mechanism is timing based: the leader is demoted when the lease check counts one contacted voter against a quorum of two, and the surviving node then stays a Candidate without advancing its term because pre-vote refuses the campaign. A fresh run with regenerated node identities and independent timing therefore checks whether the deposition and the leaderless window are properties of the staging rather than of one schedule. Either outcome is informative: the deposition reappearing strengthens the account with an independent receipt, and its absence would have to be recorded against the finding.
